D1.rationale: Every observed call is in episodes with arguments and results. No per-entry timestamps, so level 2 fails. Neither loss flag observed.

D2.rationale: No signature fields in the artifacts. Pack shows no replay mode or exercised cryptographic verification story.

D3.rationale: Order is episode-array position only. No sequence numbers, bound timestamps, or exercised hash chain.

D4.rationale: state.json carries document-level agent_id for the run holding all episodes. No cryptographic identity binding.

D5.rationale: T3 secret is cleartext three times. Redact-word count is zero. No redaction mechanism in the pack.
